difficulty_reason: After ordinary monoidal axioms, unit constraints, functor compatibility and size conventions, the author constructs the right-module endofunctor category C-prime, its strict composition tensor, and the left-multiplication monoidal equivalence, with explicit full-faithfulness and structural comparisons. This concrete general strict-model construction is the H2 burden. The coherence consequence is grouped support, not another count; source abbreviations remain unexpanded.
